input.free_text_description: This system is a data analytics platform that serves User, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including user. The platform provides capabilities for processor. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with load functionality, so that I can accomplish my load-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use processor capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
